rows.name: wps-intermediate
rows.notes: The source-agnostic WPS intermediate every registered external model already arrives as. Self-describing slab records on a regular latitude/longitude grid; no variable map is needed or allowed.

rows.name: unstructured-native-stream
rows.notes: An unstructured spherical mesh carrying a decoupled prognostic state, spelled as MPAS v8.4.1 spells it in its history, init and restart streams. Mesh and layer heights may live in a companion grid file when the state file omits them.

rows.name: unstructured-port-stream
rows.notes: The same source kind as unstructured-native-stream, spelled as this program's own forecast history spells it: the edge-normal wind is normal_u, and the frame carries no valid-time variable, so the caller's declared boundary time stands and the receipt records that it was unverified.
